Quality is good but the portion is too much.
Jul 2026 • Friends
Fluffy bread (Chang 1) is still named as one of the most famous breads in Saigon. The bowl of bread holds heavy hands, the crust of cakes is always hot and roasted. The inner ingredient is extremely high quality with super-fat paté layers, aromatic yellow butter, the same amount of cold meat, garlic, cotton rubber and thickly placed peel. The taste is strong, very characteristic and hard to find elsewhere. Too much bread and meat leads to a quick feeling. Too large quantities combined with super-fat paste butter make you eat only half a bite is starting to notice, although the restaurant has sourcings to balance the taste. A loaf of bread here is more suitable for two people to eat together than one person trying to eat it all. The price is quite high but completely proportional to the amount of food.

Authentic Banh mi so delicious it's worth the trouble of flying to eat
Feb 2026 • Solo
It was completely different from the delicious banh mi I had eaten in Japan before, and I thought it was so delicious that it was worth going all the way by plane to eat it.

It is about a 10-minute walk from Ben Thanh Market with Google Maps.
When you first come across the sign, it's for delivery and there's a public store a few blocks away.
First, line up on the left to pay for your order and then pick up your items from the right.
When I went around noon, it said M was sold out and I ordered L traditional Banh mi. 450 yen at about 73000 VND
About five minutes and the goods received
The bread is sotokari mochi and very large, and the ingredients inside are also very large.
Meat is less persistent than it looks.
Pickled vegetables are included.
Hand wipes and plastic gloves were also included.
I sat down and ate on the steps of a nearby holiday shop.
I brought a bottle of water for drinks.
If you look at other people's reviews later, you can pay by credit card, and there was an air-conditioned eat-in space next door.
(The salesperson didn't tell me that, so I thought it was another restaurant.)

I had it cut in half, but it was still quite a lot.
I ate only half of it and took it back to the hotel to eat it at night, but it was still better freshly made.
I'm going to come to the store next time without breakfast.
